Proposed API
GET reference

App Clips

List all advanced App Clip experiences for an App Clip

Read a page of app clip advanced experience resources as flat JSON objects.

GET/app-clips/{appClipId}/advanced-experiences

Proposed · Extended read design · Adapter not implemented

Request

Routes are relative to your connection. Use a facade API key; the service manages Apple authentication.

cURL
BASE='https://asc.example.com/v1/connections/conn_example'

curl --fail-with-body "$BASE/app-clips/app_clip_123/advanced-experiences" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ASC_FACADE_KEY"
JavaScript
const base = "https://asc.example.com/v1/connections/conn_example";
const response = await fetch(`${base}/app-clips/app_clip_123/advanced-experiences`, {
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.ASC_FACADE_KEY}` }
});

const body = await response.json();
if (!response.ok) {
  throw new Error(body.error?.message ?? `HTTP ${response.status}`);
}
console.log(body);
Python
import json
import os
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError

base = "https://asc.example.com/v1/connections/conn_example"
request = Request(
    f"{base}/app-clips/app_clip_123/advanced-experiences",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['ASC_FACADE_KEY']}"},
)
try:
    with urlopen(request) as response:
        print(json.load(response))
except HTTPError as error:
    detail = json.load(error)
    raise RuntimeError(detail["error"]["message"]) from error

asc.example.com is a placeholder for your deployment. Examples use fictional IDs.

Response

A page of flat objects, with an opaque continuation cursor.

200 · application/json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "app_clip_advanced_experience_123",
      "link": "https://example.com/asset",
      "version": 1,
      "status": "RECEIVED",
      "action": "OPEN",
      "isPoweredBy": false
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null
}

Illustrative response. Optional read fields may be absent or null; unknown enum values are preserved.

Response fields

NameTypeDescription
itemsobject[]The current page of plain resource objects. An empty collection returns [].
nextCursorstring | nullOpaque continuation token, or null when the collection is complete. Pass it back as cursor.

Behavior

  • A nested resource must belong to the selected parent and the configured connection. The adapter validates ownership before returning data.

Pagination

Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same filters and ordering. Stop when it is null. Each request returns one bounded page; the service never reports a capped or incomplete traversal as a complete collection.

Errors

HTTPTypeDescription
400invalid_queryUnsupported filter, sort, limit, or cursor.
401unauthorizedMissing or invalid facade API key.
403forbidden / upstream_forbiddenThe caller or configured Apple key cannot read this resource.
404resource_not_foundThe requested resource, parent, or exact locale is absent or outside the caller’s scope.
429rate_limitedA facade or Apple rate limit was reached. Respect Retry-After when returned.
502–504upstream errorApple authentication, response parsing, availability, or timeout failure; this is not an empty result.

Apple mapping

Upstream route and translation

The adapter calls GET /v1/appClips/{id}/appClipAdvancedExperiences. Read Apple’s original endpoint ↗

Flatten Apple’s attributes into each resource object. Expose supplied singleton linkage as IDs, with no automatic relationship traversal. Read access does not make these fields writable.

Facade parameterTypeDescription
statusqueryfilter[status]
placeStatusqueryfilter[placeStatus]
actionqueryfilter[action]
fieldsqueryfields[appClipAdvancedExperiences]
limitquerylimit
cursorqueryFacade-owned pagination
